_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: Determines whether you start the randomizer with Hands unlocked.
Even when disabled, Hands will always appear in Sphere 1.
Determines whether you start the randomizer with access to the Sandbox.
When enabled, Gasoline and Lighter become two distinct items, each required for BiD.
This would mean when picking up Gas and Lighter, you would receive two checks instead of one.
When enabled, each door is randomized individually instead of received altogether.
Determines whether individual cameras are randomized.
If you can access the Cameras, you can only switch to Cameras you have received.
Disabled - All cameras are available immediately.
Bundled - Cameras are unlocked in groups that match the way they're burned in BiD.
Individual - Each Camera is its own item in the randomizer.
When enabled, camera buttons such as the Music Box, Audio Lures, Power Generator, etc. are all randomized.
Power Generator is required to used the Generator in BiD's Night 21.
Special Threats (Heat and J-Choices) have their own Threat Checks.
Adds checks for each Feat.
Adds checks for each Threats and Challenges Achievement.
Adds checks for each Hub Achievement.
Adds checks for each Extra Achievement.
Determines how fishing checks are included in the randomizer.
Disabled removes all checks related to fishing.
Achievements adds checks for the Fishing Achievements.
All fish gives checks for each new fish you catch.
Achievements and Fish give checks for both the fishing achievements and each fish.
Adds a check for doing the Connection Secret in the Hub.
